entry_points.summary: [Loader API] Built-in defaults for all config keys: [notify],[docs],[brainstorm],[personas],[workflow],[followup],[axioms],[experiment],[runtime],[cost] sections (layer 1)
[Loader API] Allowed enum sets per dotted-key; hard-fail on repo/env, soft-warn on global; covers brainstorm, personas, workflow, axioms, experiment, cost keys
[Loader API] Post-validation normalizers; converts env-var strings to typed Python values for all bool/int knobs including personas.* and brainstorm.personas
[Workflow Resolver] Single source of truth for AskUserQuestion routing-class preference keys (6 workflow.* + pre_run_cost_gate); validated against VALIDATORS at module load by _run_startup_guards
[Workflow Resolver] Default overnight allowlist: {workflow.slug_confirm: recommend_derived, workflow.audit_to_amend: amend}
[Workflow Resolver] Maps (question_id, option-domain-value) -> resolver result-domain (skip|prefill|ask|halt|defer-to-sink)
[Workflow Resolver] Module-load consistency check: asserts QUESTION_IDS <= VALIDATORS and RESULT_MAP references only valid choices; raises SystemExit(2) on violation
[Loader API] Build resolved config from all 4 layers; returns (values, sources) dicts
[Loader API] Resolve and print single dotted-key value; exits 3 on unknown or meta key
[Loader API] Resolve multiple keys in one process; output JSON object {key: value}; unknown/meta keys -> null + stderr; always exits 0
[Loader API] Print export lines for all user knobs (including Z_HARNESS_BRAINSTORM_PERSONAS and Z_HARNESS_PERSONAS_*); emit config_resolved event once per run
[Loader API] Write global config with defaults + inline comments if absent; never overwrites
[Loader API] Print effective value and source layer for one key
[Workflow Resolver] Print sorted JSON array of registered question IDs; consumed by /z-suggest-memory for routing-preference validation
[Axiom Layer] Dynamically load scripts/axiom-store.py (hyphen in filename prevents normal import); cached per process; returns None when store absent or fails to import
[Axiom Layer] Load graph-valid approved axioms for a question_id; gated on axioms.enabled; returns [] when disabled, store absent, or graph validation fails
[Workflow Resolver] Merge memory match list: highest strength wins on agreement; returns (None, 'conflict', sources) when entries disagree
[Workflow Resolver] Pre-axiom resolution: config + routing-pref memory; returns 7-tuple (envelope, emit_result, emit_source, emit_strength, exit_code, resolved_value, memory_silent)
[Workflow Resolver] Full resolver: apply axiom layer on top of config+memory envelope; agree/gap-fill/direct-conflict axiom outcomes; returns 5-tuple
[Workflow Resolver] Consult 4-layer config + memory + axioms + overnight overrides; return JSON {result, default, source, rule_id, strength, reason, sources[]}; stdout reserved for JSON
[Workflow Resolver] Overnight-gate checker with cost-gate delegation path (--range-high/--severity); returns {result: halt|proceed|auto_proceed|unhandled_gate, question_id, rule_id}; always exits 0
[Workflow Resolver] Atomically write a TOML key to global or project config via tmp+rename; validates against VALIDATORS before writing; exit 2 on invalid value; exit 0 silently on success
[Loader API] List of env-only knob names (Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK, Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE, Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL, etc.) surfaced by inspect-all; not settable via TOML

[Loader API] Print all config knobs with value/source/persistence_class; covers DEFAULTS keys (incl. brainstorm.*, personas.*, cost.*) + QUESTION_IDS + ENV_ONLY_KNOBS; --json for machine-parseable output
[Loader API] Print yes|no for a given event kind; always exits 0; exits 2 on unknown event. Valid kinds: approval, phase_end, error
[Loader API] Rewrite old provider names (codex, gemini, claude) in roles.*.runtime to -cli suffixed form; applied to global + project layers; idempotent; exits 4 on I/O error
[Workflow Resolver] Walk metrics.jsonl for repeated command-pair patterns; emit JSON proposal if threshold met; never writes — caller owns write

invariants: [Loader API] schema_version current value is 2; loading a config with schema_version < 2 emits a non-fatal stderr warning pointing at `config.py ensure-defaults`; schema_version > 2 exits 2 (hard fail)

[Deprecation] load_config() emits a DEPRECATED stderr warning for every preference-class Z_HARNESS_* env var found in the raw environment (uses _collect_deprecated_env_vars — same set as export-env unset lines)
[Deprecation] runtime.env_strict = true (config.toml key, NOT a raw env var) upgrades the deprecation warning to a hard ERROR (exit 2); default false (grace period, warning only)
[Deprecation] Legal plumbing/unattended env vars (LEGAL_ENV_KEYS/LEGAL_ENV_PREFIXES) never trigger the deprecation warning — only preference-class vars do
[Deprecation] runtime.env_strict is itself a TOML config key (bool, default false); it cannot be set via a raw env var (bootstrap paradox: the env var would be deprecated by the policy it enables)
[Loader API] ensure-defaults never writes repo-local; only writes the global user path
[Loader API] should-notify always exits 0 on valid event kind (yes|no on stdout); exits 2 on unknown event
[Loader API] config_resolved event emitted at most once per $Z_HARNESS_RUN via O_EXCL temp-file de-dup
[Loader API] transliteration rule: dotted.key -> Z_HARNESS_<SECTION>_<KEY> (uppercase, dot to underscore)
[Loader API] keys must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$; hyphens or >2-level nesting exit 2
[Loader API] empty env vars are treated as missing (not as override)
[Loader API] unknown keys in TOML files are silently ignored for forward compatibility
[Loader API] global-layer enum violations: soft-warn + fall back to default; repo/env-layer violations: exit 2
[Loader API] get-batch always exits 0; unknown/meta keys -> null in output + stderr warning (never exit 3)
[Loader API] inspect-all always exits 0 on success; covers DEFAULTS keys + QUESTION_IDS + ENV_ONLY_KNOBS
[brainstorm] brainstorm.personas valid values: true | false; default true; env Z_HARNESS_BRAINSTORM_PERSONAS
[brainstorm] brainstorm.personas controls ideator persona injection in /z-brainstorm ONLY; knob lives in [brainstorm] not [personas] by design
[personas] personas.critique_panel valid values: true | false; default true; env Z_HARNESS_PERSONAS_CRITIQUE_PANEL
[personas] personas.audit valid values: true | false; default true; env Z_HARNESS_PERSONAS_AUDIT
[personas] personas.review_eval valid values: true | false; default true; env Z_HARNESS_PERSONAS_REVIEW_EVAL
[personas] personas.consult_eval valid values: true | false; default FALSE (off); env Z_HARNESS_PERSONAS_CONSULT_EVAL
[personas] personas.implementer_retry valid values: same | new; default same; env Z_HARNESS_PERSONAS_IMPLEMENTER_RETRY
[personas] there is NO personas.debug knob — it was removed as dead code; do not document or configure it
[personas] personas.consult_eval=false (default) means the neutral consult arm runs alone at convergent sites — no advisory overhead
[personas] personas.implementer_retry has no effect when experiment.persona_rotation=false
[personas] neutral-authority invariant: at all CONVERGENT sites the neutral arm is always the decision of record regardless of knob state
[axioms] axioms.enabled valid values: true | false; default true; env Z_HARNESS_AXIOMS_ENABLED
[axioms] axioms.kernel_budget_chars valid values: positive integer (>=1); default 6000; env Z_HARNESS_AXIOMS_KERNEL_BUDGET_CHARS
[axioms] axioms.extract_min_recurrence valid values: positive integer (>=1); default 3; env Z_HARNESS_AXIOMS_EXTRACT_MIN_RECURRENCE
[axioms] axioms.auto_extract_post_run valid values: true | false; default true; env Z_HARNESS_AXIOMS_AUTO_EXTRACT_POST_RUN
[axioms] axioms.enabled=false causes _load_axiom_matches to return [] immediately; envelope is byte-identical to pre-axiom result
[axioms] axiom layer is lowest precedence: config and memory always win; axiom only fills a gap (config at default AND memory silent)
[experiment] experiment.persona_rotation valid values: true | false; default true; env Z_HARNESS_EXPERIMENT_PERSONA_ROTATION
[experiment] experiment.control_every_n valid values: positive integer; default 5; env Z_HARNESS_EXPERIMENT_CONTROL_EVERY_N
[experiment] experiment.persona_rotation = false is a complete no-op: no draw events, no state files, no PERSONA_PREFIX, no persona_attempt_outcome
[cost] cost.token_budget valid values: positive int or null; default null; env Z_HARNESS_COST_TOKEN_BUDGET
[cost] cost.token_budget=null means no budget; check-no-ask with --severity hard under NO_ASK=halt halts with rule_id: cost_budget_missing
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.audit_to_amend valid values: ask | amend | stop; default ask
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.slug_confirm valid values: ask | auto_accept | recommend_derived; default ask
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.implement_all_proceed valid values: ask | auto_resume | halt; default ask
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.review_all_proceed valid values: ask | proceed | halt; default ask
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.plan_decisions_approval valid values: ask | approve | halt; default ask
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.spec_retro_discovery valid values: ask | defer_to_sink_p2; default ask
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.pre_run_cost_gate valid values: ask | auto_proceed | halt; default ask
resolve-question stdout is reserved exclusively for JSON; all diagnostics route to stderr
Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL=1 short-circuits resolve-question to always return {result: ask, source: override}
resolve-question exit 0 = valid JSON; exit 2 = bad invocation; exit 3 = unknown question_id; exit 4 = I/O error; exit 5 = config conflict (ASK_ALL=1 + NO_ASK=halt)
QUESTION_IDS registry is the single source of truth; _run_startup_guards() asserts set(QUESTION_IDS) <= set(VALIDATORS) at module load
Resolver is read-only — never writes to config or memory; all writes go through config.py set or /z-suggest-memory
config.py set writes atomically via tmp+rename; validates against VALIDATORS before writing; exits 0 silently on success; exit 2 on invalid value
[Overnight gate] Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt activates overnight mode; _apply_overnight_overrides post-processes every resolve-question envelope
[Overnight gate] Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL=1 + Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt are mutually exclusive; resolve-question exits 5 on conflict
[Overnight gate] OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_QIDS_DEFAULT = {workflow.slug_confirm: recommend_derived, workflow.audit_to_amend: amend}
[Overnight gate] check-no-ask fails closed: unregistered question_id with NO_ASK=halt -> halt + unknown_ask_blocked event
[Overnight gate] check-no-ask --severity soft always returns auto_proceed regardless of policy
[followup] followup.default_sink valid values: project | global; default project
[followup] followup.notion_enabled valid values: true | false; default false
[followup] followup.auto_close_low_risk_enabled valid values: true | false; default TRUE (on by default)
[followup] Z_HARNESS_NOTION_TOKEN is env-only (not a TOML key); read by notion-push.py _resolve_token(); never log it

[active-plan] Z_HARNESS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT, Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR, Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_ENABLED, Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_STALE_SECS, Z_HARNESS_STRICT_OVERLAP are NOT in config.py DEFAULTS/VALIDATORS; consumed by plan-path.sh and active-plan-registry.py only
[claim-lock] Z_HARNESS_CLAIM_TTL_SECS (default 2700), Z_HARNESS_CLAIM_OVERRIDE, Z_HARNESS_CLAIM_DISABLE are env-only (NOT TOML keys); read inline by plan-claim.sh; NOT emitted by export-env
[claim-lock] Z_HARNESS_CLAIM_DISABLE=1 makes every plan-claim.sh subcommand an immediate exit-0 no-op; release is a safe no-op without event-presence gate
[claim-lock] exit-2 from acquire is the normal post-crash recovery path (setsid-detached daemon survives SIGKILL, leaks until TTL); unattended exit-2 default-aborts unless Z_HARNESS_CLAIM_OVERRIDE=1
[claim-lock] heartbeat exit-9 fires ONLY on confirmed ownership change; transient read error is heartbeat_error + exit-0 (NOT exit-9)
gotchas: [brainstorm] brainstorm.personas remains in [brainstorm] not [personas] — do NOT move it; existing configs already have it there
[personas] personas.consult_eval defaults OFF (false) — most expensive advisory arm; enabling it adds one extra subagent call at every convergent eval site
[personas] there is NO personas.debug knob — it was removed as dead; do not configure or document it
[personas] personas.implementer_retry is a no-op when experiment.persona_rotation=false regardless of its value
[personas] Global layer violations are soft (warn + default); repo/env layer violations exit 2 (hard fail)
[axioms] axioms.kernel_budget_chars and axioms.extract_min_recurrence must be positive integers; string '0' fails validation (positive means >=1)
[axioms] axiom-store.py is loaded via importlib (not normal import) because the filename has a hyphen; module load failures are silently tolerated
[experiment] Global layer experiment.* violations are soft; repo/env layer violations exit 2 (hard fail)
[cost] cost.token_budget=null (default) causes check-no-ask to halt with cost_budget_missing under NO_ASK=halt policy; must be explicitly set for overnight cost-gate to auto-proceed
[Loader API] Global config validation is soft (warn + default fallback); repo/env config validation is hard (exit 2)
[Deprecation] runtime.env_strict cannot be set via env — the env transliteration Z_HARNESS_RUNTIME_ENV_STRICT is blocked by the very deprecation policy it controls; only set it via config.toml
[Loader API] docs.always_apply=never only suppresses doc-fetcher in light flows (/z-do); heavy flows always dispatch doc-fetcher regardless
[Loader API] cmd_set exits 0 silently on success — no stdout output; do not parse stdout from cmd_set
[Loader API] Valid event kinds for should-notify: approval, phase_end, error only. Passing run_complete exits 2; guard with || true if needed
[Loader API] get-batch always exits 0 unlike get which exits 3 on unknown keys — callers must check for null values in JSON output
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.slug_confirm value domain (ask/auto_accept/recommend_derived) is NOT the same as the resolver result domain; RESULT_MAP translates between them
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.pre_run_cost_gate is a registered question_id; overnight allowlist can auto-decide it via Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE
[Overnight gate] Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL=1 + Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt both set causes exit 5 from resolve-question — not a soft error
[defer-to-sink] result==defer-to-sink must NOT be treated as skip — orchestrator must explicitly call scripts/sink-add.sh
[followup] Array-typed followup keys (path_allowlist, path_denylist, audit_evidence_required_artifacts) are not in VALIDATORS; no enum validation
[followup] auto_close_low_risk_enabled defaults to TRUE (on) — do not assume it is off by default
[followup] Z_HARNESS_NOTION_TOKEN is env-only; callers must NOT run notion-push.py under set -x (token leaks into logs)
[active-plan] Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_ENABLED, Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_STALE_SECS, Z_HARNESS_STRICT_OVERLAP, Z_HARNESS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT, Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR are NOT surfaced by inspect-all
[claim-lock] Z_HARNESS_CLAIM_TTL_SECS, Z_HARNESS_CLAIM_OVERRIDE, Z_HARNESS_CLAIM_DISABLE are NOT TOML keys and NOT emitted by export-env; set only via environment
[claim-lock] release is always safe to call even when Z_HARNESS_CLAIM_DISABLE=1; it is a true no-op (not gated on event presence)
[claim-lock] do NOT conflate heartbeat exit-9 (confirmed ownership change) with heartbeat_error (transient read, exit-0); they have opposite severities

workflow.audit_to_amend.description: Controls Phase 5 AskUserQuestion in /z-audit-plan and /z-audit-plan-style. ask=always prompt; amend=auto-proceed as amend; stop=auto-stop

workflow.slug_confirm.description: Controls soft non-obvious-slug confirmation at 7 callsites. ask=always prompt; auto_accept=silently accept (resolver returns skip); recommend_derived=pre-select (resolver returns prefill). Collision check always runs unconditionally.

workflow.implement_all_proceed.description: Controls halt-resolution gate in /z-implement-all. ask=always prompt; auto_resume=skip prompt; halt=stop unconditionally

workflow.plan_decisions_approval.description: Controls Phase 2.5 decisions-doc approval gate in /z-plan

workflow.spec_retro_discovery.description: Controls how Phase 4 of /z-implement-next handles out-of-current-SPEC discoveries. ask=interactive prompt; defer_to_sink_p2=park as P2 follow-up in project sink

workflow.pre_run_cost_gate.description: Controls pre-run cost gate for z-research/z-uplift/z-plan-split. ask=prompt; auto_proceed=skip gate; halt=stop unconditionally. Also consumed by check-no-ask --range-high/--severity delegation path.

brainstorm_section.description: Controls persona injection in /z-brainstorm. Back-compat location — do not move to [personas].

brainstorm.personas.description: Enable persona injection for up to 3 distinct ideator roles in /z-brainstorm. When OFF the dispatch is byte-identical to the pre-feature vendor-only brainstorm.

personas_section.description: Controls per-surface persona dispatch across all z-harness commands. Each boolean enables/disables persona injection at one dispatch site class. There is NO personas.debug knob — it was removed as dead code.

personas.critique_panel.description: Enable persona injection at the z-plan Phase 3 + Phase 7 fixed 5-panel critique arms (DIVERGENT). When ON, 5 distinct consultant personas are drawn and positionally prepended.

personas.audit.description: Enable persona injection at z-audit dimension auditors (DIVERGENT). When ON, one distinct audit_persona is drawn per dimension (correctness/perf/cleanliness/design).

personas.review_eval.description: Enable the advisory persona reviewer at code-review gates — z-implement-all, z-implement-next, z-plan-light, z-fix, z-do (CONVERGENT). Advisory only — never changes pass/fail outcome.

personas.consult_eval.description: Enable the advisory persona consult arm at convergent evaluation sites — z-plan-light bundled consult and z-audit bundled consult (CONVERGENT). DEFAULT OFF — most expensive and lowest-signal advisory arm. Advisory only.

personas.implementer_retry.description: Controls implementer persona strategy on retry. same=reuse cycle-1 persona for all retries (lifecycle traceability). new=fresh draw excluding prior persona on each retry. No effect when experiment.persona_rotation=false.

axioms_section.description: Configuration for the axiom extraction pipeline and axiom resolver layer. Axioms are the lowest-precedence signal in resolve-question.

axioms.enabled.description: Master kill-switch. When false, _load_axiom_matches returns [] immediately and auto_extract_post_run is suppressed.

axioms.kernel_budget_chars.description: Max chars of axiom text in context kernel. Must be positive integer (>=1).

axioms.extract_min_recurrence.description: Min recurrence count before auto-extracting an axiom candidate. Must be positive integer (>=1).

axioms.auto_extract_post_run.description: When true, runs axiom extraction pipeline automatically at end of each /z-* run.

experiment_section.description: Feature-flag knobs for the persona-rotation data-collection experiment. All keys are on by default.

experiment.persona_rotation.description: Master on/off switch for persona rotation in z-implement-all, z-implement-next, z-plan, z-debug. false = complete no-op.

experiment.control_every_n.description: Forced-control cadence: every Nth implementer attempt (repo-wide counter in .z-harness/.persona-control-counter) uses boring-anchor.

cost_section.description: Token budget configuration for cost-gate delegation. Used by check-no-ask when invoked with --range-high and --severity.

cost.token_budget.description: Token budget ceiling. When set, check-no-ask --severity hard compares range_high against this value. null=budget not configured; hard gates under NO_ASK=halt will halt with cost_budget_missing.

followup_namespace.description: Configuration for the follow-up registry. All keys live under the [followup] TOML section.

followup.default_sink.description: Which sink new entries go to when no explicit --sink= flag is passed to sink-add.sh

followup.auto_close_low_risk_enabled.description: Master kill-switch for auto-close-low-risk path. DEFAULT IS TRUE (on).

followup.staleness_commit_window.description: Commit distance above which staleness prompt fires at claim time.

followup.staleness_warn_days.description: Age in days after which a soft staleness warning is shown at claim time.

followup.staleness_hard_dismiss_days.description: Age in days after which entries are auto-dismissed. 0 = disabled (default).

followup.audit_evidence_required_artifac.description: Named artifact kinds that must be present in an audit_evidence.json blob.

Z_HARNESS_NOTION_TOKEN.description: Notion API token override. When non-empty, bypasses followup.notion_token_path lookup. Not a TOML key. Never log it.

env_vars.Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK: Set to 'halt' to activate overnight mode
env_vars.Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE: JSON object {question_id: value}; merged over OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_QIDS_DEFAULT
env_vars.Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL: Set to '1' to force all questions to ask; mutually exclusive with Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt (exit 5)

active_plan_env_knobs.description: Env-only knobs for the external artifact base and active-plan registry. NOT in config.py DEFAULTS/VALIDATORS/ENV_ONLY_KNOBS. Consumed by scripts/plan-path.sh and scripts/active-plan-registry.py. inspect-all does NOT surface these.

Z_HARNESS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT.description: Controls base fallback chain tiers 2-4. 0=opt-out to old in-repo behavior.

Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR.description: TRUE ESCAPE HATCH: explicit absolute base dir override; bypasses .z-harness-base anchor.

Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_ENABLED.description: Set to 0 to disable active-plan registry subcommands (except list and session-id).

Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_STALE_SECS.description: Seconds after which last_heartbeat is considered stale.

Z_HARNESS_STRICT_OVERLAP.description: Set to 1 for blocking-overlap mode (exit 20 on explicit*explicit path match).

claim_lock_env_knobs.description: Env-only knobs for the slug-level hard claim lock in /z-plan and /z-audit-plan. NOT in config.py DEFAULTS/VALIDATORS. Consumed by scripts/plan-claim.sh directly from the environment. NOT emitted by export-env. See docs/human/plan-claim.md for the full design reference.

Z_HARNESS_CLAIM_TTL_SECS.description: TTL (seconds) for slug claim liveness. Heartbeat not refreshed within this window causes stale-takeover (exit 2) on next acquire.

Z_HARNESS_CLAIM_OVERRIDE.description: Set to 1 to allow unattended (Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK) runs to proceed through contention (exit 1), stale-takeover (exit 2), or corrupt lock (exit 3) without aborting.

Z_HARNESS_CLAIM_DISABLE.description: Set to 1 to skip all claim locking. Every plan-claim.sh subcommand (acquire, heartbeat, release) is an immediate exit-0 no-op. Release is a safe no-op without event-presence gate.

resolve_question_envelope.source: config | memory | axiom | axiom_conflict | conflict | none | override | overnight_allowlist | no_ask_halt
resolve_question_envelope.strength: hard | very_strong | strong | weak | soft | none | policy

v2_deferrals: Stale-memory hygiene: when routing-preference memory exists and user later writes same question_id to config, v1 only warns (memory_potentially_superseded); v2 will add cleanup prompt
Async memory-write telemetry: propose_accepted event logged only after /z-suggest-memory returns 0
Multi-IDE export precheck integration: Cursor/Codex/agy fall back to raw AskUserQuestion in v1
Halt-class bypass (spec_problem, decision_needed): explicitly out of v1
